# External transport of the fixed review rules to the JODIE MOOC stream

Use the pinned author MOOC export matched in the parent interaction study to the SNAP action archive. Evaluate the original longer-inactivity-first and fewer-total-actions-first rankings unchanged. The event is a learner's first recorded positive state flag. The roster comprises learners with an observed action by each landmark. An actionable positive has its first flag strictly after the landmark but before the stream ends. An unflagged learner is a negative for this finite observation window. No course-enrollment or administrative exit date is released. Audit repeated flags, post-flag actions and follow-up duration. These conditions permit a first-event risk-set study even if other actions occur after a flag. They limit interpretation as formal withdrawal.

Fix the primary landmark at the midpoint between first and last timestamp, and report quarter and three-quarter times as sensitivity analyses. Keep floor(10% of observed active learners) seats for every ranking and lag at that landmark. Compare current first-flag status, reporting lags of 1, 7 and 30 days (86400 seconds per day), and no status feed. For lag L exclude learners whose first flag occurred at or before t−L. Use only action count and last action time up to t. In addition to uniform selection, keep both opposite directions (recently active first and many actions first): observed future flags require future activity logging. Use fractional inclusion at all boundary ties. Report every cell, including zero captures. No model is fitted.

On the midpoint cohort resample entire learners 2,000 times with replacement (NumPy seed 20261122), keep the observed number of review seats, and refill queues including ties in each draw. For each of the four nonuniform rankings at current and absent status, report the difference in actionable cases per seat against uniform with Bonferroni simultaneous percentile intervals over eight comparisons. The transport question is whether each original rule beats uniform with current status and loses without it in this source. No new effect-size threshold and no method superiority claim. The source was previously used for a different action-level prediction study. The goal is an externally sourced test of the queue mechanism, conditional on this observed provider, its chosen landmarks and fixed follow-up.
